title: Listing Quality Program — Rating Thresholds and Assessment Calendar for Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Listing Quality Program: Thresholds and Calendar

The Roamhaven Listings quality program assesses each listing's guest ratings on a fixed calendar against thresholds set by the listing's space type.

## Thresholds by space type

| Space type | Suspension below (average stars) | Warning below (average stars) | Guest reviews needed before a listing is assessed | Lookback (calendar days of guest reviews) | Days a quality-suspended listing stays suspended before it can be reinstated | Confirmed stays of a quality-suspended listing go ahead |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | 3.80 | 4.10 | 5 | 365 | 30 | yes |
| Private Room | 3.90 | 4.20 | 5 | 365 | 30 | yes |
| Entire Guest Suite | 4.00 | 4.30 | 5 | 365 | 30 | yes |
| Entire Apartment | 4.00 | 4.30 | 5 | 365 | 30 | yes |
| Entire Home | 4.00 | 4.30 | 5 | 365 | 30 | yes |
| Luxury Villa | 4.70 | 4.80 | 3 | 365 | 60 | yes |

## Assessment calendar

For every space type, quality assessments run on the **first calendar day of January, April, July and October**.

## How the two rating figures relate

- The **suspension figure** is the average guest rating below which the listing is suspended at a quality assessment.
- The **warning figure** is the average guest rating below which — while still at or above the suspension figure — the listing receives a quality warning.
- The **reviews figure** is the number of guest reviews within the lookback that a listing needs before it is assessed at all.

## Reading examples (hypothetical averages)

| Space type | Average guest rating | Where it falls |
|---|---|---|
| Private Room | 3.89 | below the suspension figure of 3.90 |
| Private Room | 3.90 | at the suspension figure, below the warning figure of 4.20 |
| Private Room | 4.20 | at the warning figure |
| Luxury Villa | 4.75 | at or above 4.70 and below 4.80 |
| Luxury Villa | 4.80 | at the warning figure |

A quality-suspended Shared Room cannot be reinstated before 30 days have run; a quality-suspended Luxury Villa not before 60.
